justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/parser/zing/ZingLogParser.java, ZingLine.java, and ZingLineType.java. The package contains only 3 classes totaling 693 LOC, with a narrow scope: one parser that reads Zing compilation log lines and emits tags, one data holder, and one 2-value enum. That is a small, focused package rather than an excessively large or responsibility-heavy God Component.
